name: activin A receptor type 2A
pathways: positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction
positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ACVR2A encodes activin receptor type-2A. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Colorectal Adenocarcinoma; Hepatocellular Carcinoma; Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
